AppointmentSeries.title: Appointment Series
AppointmentSeries.description: A recurring appointment series (bookings-depth, recurring-appointment-series). Holds the RRULE-style recurrence definition and the base occurrence template (service, resource, first start, duration). The RecurringSeriesService expands the rule into individual Appointment records, each carrying seriesId + recurrenceIndex, skipping occurrences that violate the existing availability/conflict rules (SlotService). Per bookings/spec.md this realises the Tier-2 recurring-bookings enhancement deferred by the foundation change.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration for tenant isolation (ADR-005).
administrationId.title: Administration

seriesId.description: Operator-assigned unique series identifier within the administration.
seriesId.title: Series Id

serviceId.description: FK to Service.serviceId — the booked service for every occurrence.
serviceId.title: Service

resourceId.description: FK to Resource.resourceId — the resource every occurrence is booked against.
resourceId.title: Resource

customerId.description: FK to the customer the series is booked for (optional).
customerId.title: Customer

startTime.description: First occurrence start in ISO 8601 UTC. Subsequent occurrences are derived by applying recurrenceRule.
startTime.title: Start Time

durationMinutes.description: Duration in minutes applied to every generated occurrence (occurrence endTime = startTime + durationMinutes).
durationMinutes.title: Duration (minutes)

recurrenceRule.description: RRULE-style recurrence string (RFC 5545 subset): FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY;INTERVAL=n;COUNT=n|UNTIL=YYYYMMDD;BYDAY=MO,TU,... Expanded by RecurringSeriesService.
recurrenceRule.title: Recurrence Rule

status.description: Series lifecycle state. Cancelling a series does not retroactively cancel already-generated appointments.
status.title: Status

generatedCount.description: Number of individual appointments successfully generated from this series.
generatedCount.title: Generated Count

skippedCount.description: Number of occurrences skipped because they violated the availability/conflict rules.
skippedCount.title: Skipped Count

Appointment.description: Partial overlay (ADR-037 additive merge) onto the Appointment register owned by the bookings-create-appointment fragment (10-bookings-create-appointment.json). Adds the bookings-depth fields: recurrence linkage (seriesId + recurrenceIndex, set when an appointment is generated from an AppointmentSeries) and no-show-fee capture bookkeeping (noShowFeeAmount / noShowFeeStatus / noShowFeePaymentIntentId / noShowFeeCapturedAt, set by NoShowFeeCaptureService when a no-show fee is charged via the payment-provider rails). All fields are optional so they are deliberately NOT added to the base schema's required list.

seriesId.description: FK to AppointmentSeries.seriesId when this appointment was generated from a recurring series; null for a standalone booking.
seriesId.title: Series

recurrenceIndex.description: Zero-based ordinal of this occurrence within its series (0 = first occurrence).
recurrenceIndex.title: Recurrence Index

noShowFeeAmount.description: No-show fee charged in integer cents = round(appointmentCost * appliedPolicy.noShowFee / 100). Set by NoShowFeeCaptureService when a no-show is recorded and a fee is defined.
noShowFeeAmount.title: No-Show Fee Amount

noShowFeeStatus.description: Lifecycle of the no-show-fee charge. `none` = no fee defined; `captured` = charged via the provider; `failed` = the capture call failed; `waived` = operator waived it.
noShowFeeStatus.title: No-Show Fee Status

noShowFeePaymentIntentId.description: Gateway-side payment intent id for the no-show-fee capture (from the DepositPayment adapter result).
noShowFeePaymentIntentId.title: No-Show Fee Payment Intent

noShowFeeCapturedAt.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) when the no-show fee was captured.
noShowFeeCapturedAt.title: No-Show Fee Captured At
